dataset_name: JanDarpan Delhi Public Representatives - Initial Data Pack

checks.detail: 77 rows; expected 70 MLAs + 7 Lok Sabha MPs
AC numbers form an exact sequence from 1 to 70
70 unique constituency labels after case folding
70 unique MLA names after case folding
No residential address, personal phone or email columns in officials.csv
3 Rajya Sabha rows stored separately from 7 Lok Sabha MPs
One explicit enrichment queue row per official; affidavit values intentionally blank
Gajender Singh Daral vs Gajender Drall; Jitender Kumar vs Jitender Mahajan are flagged and not silently merged
Attendance percentages within 0-100 and question counts nonnegative

limitations: This is a validated base roster and partial legislative-metrics snapshot, not a complete dossier for all 77 people.
Individual ECI affidavit documents were not individually matched, extracted and human-reviewed; assets, liabilities, education and criminal-case fields remain blank by design.
MLA vote totals, vote shares and winning margins were not imported.
PRS activity fields are secondary-source observations, may be incomplete and should not be used as an overall representative score.
Two PRS name discrepancies are excluded from identity-level joining pending review.

MLA individual roster document is dated 2025-08; current official eVidhan portal confirms 70 Assembly members and party totals, while Assembly history lists VIII term membership. Recheck individual roster before production publication.
